# MatchApp TV Ai
> AI entertainment concierge. One title for tonight and the official place to watch it.

MatchApp recommends movies, TV series, K-drama, anime, novelas, vertical micro-dramas, Kids titles, FAST/Roku shows, podcasts and live 2026 events. Ask in 14 languages. Availability is a guide, not a pirate stream.

## Product
- Homepage / what to watch tonight: https://matchapp.tv/
- Ask AI (synopsis, where to watch, when it starts): https://matchapp.tv/discover.html
- Kids Mode (age-banded, 64 titles): https://matchapp.tv/kids/
- Classic cartoons: https://matchapp.tv/kids/nostalgia/
- Match Together (two tastes, one title): https://matchapp.tv/together.html
- Where to watch: https://matchapp.tv/where-to-watch/
- The Roku Channel / FAST TV: https://matchapp.tv/platforms/roku-channel/
- Live events (Asian Games, F1 Baku, LoL Worlds): https://matchapp.tv/events-archive.html
- Pricing (VIP, Extra Matches, Ask AI credits): https://matchapp.tv/pricing/pricing.html
- About: https://matchapp.tv/about.html
- Updates: https://matchapp.tv/updates.html

## Optional
- Sitemap: https://matchapp.tv/sitemap.xml
- Ads: https://matchapp.tv/ads.txt

## Do not index
Account, checkout and diagnostic URLs are private: /purchase.html, /profile/, /oauth/, /callback.html, /register.html, /reset.html.
